stories.detail: From everyone at Wagga Wagga Country Club, welcome Shaun Tipping of Howlong Country GC. Have a great round.

stories.detail: A run of 7 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.detail: 4 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.detail: 4 twos in a row on holes 15-18 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper

stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 16, 17 & 18 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.detail: 5 3-pointers+ harvested from the round - relentless

comingLast.roast: holding them on 18 - at least the 37 km/h wind shares the guilt
averaging 0.6 a hole - the blue balls are warming up
safe by 2 unless the course gets generous late
in on a 5-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
5 clear from the bar stool - the best kind of clear
5 from the double blue - a wipe here would be extremely on-brand
6 above Mort and in - now it is all spectator sport with stakes
in the clubhouse, 6 points of daylight, one nervous eye on the scorers
finished 6 above the blue line - toasting every point Mort does not score
done and 6 above the drop - his interest in Mort's round is intense and personal
